body_height_definition: One fixed source-pixel anatomy scale, idle crown y168 to projected midpoint of both boot contact centers y604; excludes weapon and raised hands. No per-frame fitted scale.

atlas_layout.arrangement: four separate poses in two rows; adaptive disjoint source cells
atlas_layout.instruction: Use explicit region rectangles and absolute source anchors. Row boundary y691 and lower-row column boundary x714 lie in entirely clear alpha>16 gutters; preserves complete silhouettes crossing nominal 627px grid.

frames.name: idle
frames.pose: Rear northwest-facing grounded low two-handed axe ready.

frames.name: windup
frames.pose: Rear view with complete axe overhead and loaded knees.

frames.name: release

anchor_convention.coordinates: Absolute source pixels, x right/y down.
anchor_convention.foot: Projected midpoint of both boot sole contact centers, not lowest silhouette pixel.
anchor_convention.head: Crown landmark for anatomy; not face center.
anchor_convention.grip: Midpoint of two hands on axe haft; rear hand can be hidden.
anchor_convention.muzzle: Inherited runtime label for center of outer SILVER AXE CUTTING EDGE, not a firearm.
anchor_convention.measurement: Read-only visual anatomical estimates; crown/feet approximately +/-10 px, partly hidden grip/blade approx +/-12 px. Source PNG has not been cropped/edited.

provenance.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production transparent CH01 storybook BACK-view 4-pose game sprite atlas, requested 1024 x 1024 PNG, exact 2-column by2-row layout with four completely isolated full-body keyposes.
Input images: Image1 is CH01's exact identity/outfit/art-style portrait. Image2 is the already-approved FULL-BODY FRONT action atlas of this same character: use identical complete armor, boots, orange-red scarf, axe design, body proportions and clean cel-painted shading. Rotate its whole character to BACK northwest-facing view; do NOT simply copy front faces. Image3 selected option3 concept is only sunny fantasy visual style/camera reference, no UI or scene.
Character: same adult male AXE-warrior in every cell, windswept spiky dark brown hair visible from back, face mostly hidden, orange-red scarf and small flowing cloth, matte charcoal-black armor with warm copper-gold/brass trim, dark armored trousers, black/copper greaves and boots. Armor's back plate has same restrained gold star/ornamental styling and simple leather harness. Single complete BATTLE AXE with broad silver cutting blade, orange-black side plate and flat rear poll, thick short brown-wrapped haft held by two hands. NO gun, rifle, flamethrower, hammer or helmet.
Camera/style: full-body 3/4 TOP-DOWN isometric camera elevated about35degrees, character faces northwest toward upper left, viewer sees back and slightly left side. Match Image2's precise clean hand-painted cel-polished fantasy sprite illustration, warm colored outlines, controlled readable game detail; NOT photorealistic.
Layout: four whole figures in a separated two-by-two layout on true transparent alpha. Row-major top-left idle, top-right windup, bottom-left release, bottom-right recovery. Make each figure and entire axe SMALLER inside each cell than Image2: body head-to-boot height about58%cell height and full pose including axe no larger than70%cellheight or70%cellwidth. Feet contact midpoint near x50%, y80%cell; normal crown near y22%. At least60pixel safe completely transparent gutters between figures and around every silhouette, no crossing row/column boundaries or outer edge. Same anatomy scale in all four poses; crouch/lunge allowed but no per-pose resizing.
Poses: idle=grounded low two-handed axe ready; windup=complete axe lifted diagonally overhead, knees/waist loaded; release=committed forward/down cleave toward northwest/up-left with extended arms and wide braced stance; recovery=lower sunk stance, bent arms drawing axe low back across thighs. Back angle and axe continuity correct across all poses.
Constraints: EXACTLY four isolated keyposes, no extras. Transparent outside all silhouettes and gutters. No ground/scenery/background/shadows, motion streaks or slash effects, text, labels, UI, grids, borders, frames or watermark. All hair, soles, hands and axe completely visible and uncropped. Ensure axe is a sharp-bladed axe, not a blunt hammer.

limitations: Four authored key poses; no in-between generation.
Prompt60px gutters were not achieved at source sides; full meaningful silhouettes are kept using adaptive regions.
Runtime orientation/mirroring and contact placement pending integrator review.
